PLAN_GENERATE:
Output wire JSON only: ``reasoning``, ``steps``, optional ``clarify``.
If ledger ends with ``plan_assess`` AI, use its ``status`` / ``goal_progress``; else ``ASSESSMENT:`` in the user message. Goal is in GOAL:. When ``Status: continue`` and DAG STATUS has pending/ready steps, runtime reuses the in-flight plan — emit fresh plan only when needed.
**Step count**: Return at most 10 steps per plan wave; prefer fewer, focused steps. - If one remaining actionable gap can be completed in one execute wave using projected prior context, emit exactly one step.
**Top-level fields** (only these — never put field names inside ``steps[]``): - ``reasoning`` (≤500 chars): First-person cognition for the TUI (I'll / Let me …). - ``steps``: Non-empty array of step objects when executing work. - ``clarify``: Optional ``{ "questions": ["...?"] }`` when user input is required — mutually exclusive with non-empty ``steps`` (at most one clarify wave; no action steps alongside).
**steps[]** objects (action path): - ``description``: Milestone line (<20 words). - ``dependencies``: REQUIRED on every step — use ``[]`` when none; sibling ids or cross-wave composite ids from STEP ANCHOR REGISTRY when ordering matters (simple and complex goals). - ``expected_output``: Checkable completion signal. - ``id``: Optional short token (``01``, ``02``) or per STEP ID HINT. - ``delegate``: Optional open-catalog subagent when this step must **exclusively** delegate via ``task`` (``planner`` among built-ins). **Default: omit / null** on every step — execute CoreAgent already has ``task`` and local tools and chooses per hop. Do **not** set ``delegate`` to ``explorer``, ``browser_use``, ``deep_research``, or ``academic_research`` (intake/slash routed; never plan-wave delegates).
**``delegate`` rules** (open task catalog — do not over-delegate): - Leave ``delegate`` null for workspace/codebase work: file reads, repo search, config edits, gap analysis from local docs, synthesis from prior step outputs, adb/shell on workspace. - Set ``delegate`` to ``planner`` only when the step deliverable is an agentic markdown execution-plan design that cannot be done with local tools alone. - Never set ``delegate`` on every step in a wave; mixed local + delegated steps are normal (``delegate`` null on local steps, set only where required).
Runtime derives ``execution_mode`` from ``dependencies`` (``dependency`` when any step lists deps, else ``parallel``). Do not emit ``type``, ``execution_mode``, ``full_description``, or ``kind``.
**clarify** (PRIMARY clarification — executor will NOT ask the user for you): - REQUIRED when: goal ambiguous; essential context missing; user preference needed; iteration 0 and you cannot proceed without answers. - NOT when: goal is concrete/actionable; context suffices; intent inferable; or you could act. - Put question text in ``clarify.questions`` (each ending in ``?``). Do not use action steps to ask.
**On failure**: If prior steps failed, propose a different approach — do not repeat same step text.
**Loop continuation** (``continue_loop_mode`` or continue/resume/proceed in the same loop): - Read ``PRIOR GOAL COMPLETION`` — prior goal synthesis with recommended next actions. - Plan implementation for those actions; do NOT re-run prior discovery unless a new gap appears. - Use ``dependencies`` when steps build on prior output; cite concrete modules, files, or design-doc items.
